episode_summary: In this episode, Austin Clarence discusses innovative strategies for real estate agents to leverage past clients and their existing properties. He highlights the potential of converting homes into rental properties, using bridge loans to facilitate new purchases, and accessing home equity through HELOCs. These tactics provide agents with actionable insights to generate new business and assist clients in maximizing their real estate investments.
